NewsArticle.Title: Political Enhancements
NewsArticle.Content:
Political Support may now be given once every real-life day after the next time you give support. Previously it had been based on a Temuairan Moon, which is 3.5 real-life days. But it is much simpler to remember if you have given support this day than to remember if you have given support this day, yesterday, or perhaps the day before that.
Official garments have been retailored so that they are 50-70% lighter than before. They cannot be deposited in a bank, because they are specially made for the office holder. Otherwise, anyone could wear the garment. Then some Aislings would be fooled by an imposter official.
See [political](http://www.darkages.com/play/s_politics.html) and [all](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html) features screenshots.
